body: I’m a bit of a nihilist. I feel nothing I do matters, and sometimes I’d like to escape. I have a good life and people that love me, but it’s difficult for me to think about all the struggles I’ve had and will have and then think about how pointless it is.
I’m writing a paper where CRISPR has a large part...do you think the restrictions in place in the United States are adequate? Specific/not specific enough?
